source: Lizhang Chen⟦0⟧ Jonathan Li⟦1⟧ Chen Liang Ni Lao Qiang Liu

source: Abstract
translation: 摘要

source: We introduce training-free looped transformers, in which a lightweight inferencetime wrapper loops a contiguous mid-stack block of layers of a frozen checkpoint without additional fine-tuning, continued training, or architectural changes. Unlike prior looped transformer methods that train with the looped structure end-to-end, we retrofit recurrence onto pretrained models at test time. We show that naive block reapplication usually degrades performance, highlighting the importance of the loop application strategy. Motivated by viewing a pre-norm transformer block as a forward Euler step on an ODE, we instead treat looping as a refinement of the same approximation, replacing one large update with smaller damped sub-steps. Across seven dense, sparse MoE, and MLA+MoE model families, our method improves Qwen3-4B-Instruct by +2.64 pp on MMLU-Pro, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct by +1.14 pp on CommonsenseQA, and Moonlight-16B-A3B-Instruct by +1.20 pp on OpenBookQA.
translation: 本文提出免训练循环变换器，其中轻量级推理时包装器循环冻结检查点的连续中间层块，无需额外微调、继续训练或架构更改。与先前端到端训练循环结构的循环变换器方法不同，我们在测试时将循环性改装到预训练模型上。我们表明，朴素的块重复应用通常会降低性能，凸显了循环应用策略的重要性。受将预归一化变换器块视为常微分方程上前向欧拉步骤的启发，我们转而将循环视为对同一近似的细化，用较小的阻尼子步骤取代一次大的更新。在七个稠密、稀疏专家混合以及多头潜在注意力加专家混合模型家族中，我们的方法在 MMLU-Pro 上将 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 提升 +2.64 个百分点，在 CommonsenseQA 上将 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct 提升 +1.14 个百分点，在 OpenBookQA 上将 Moonlight-16B-A3B-Instruct 提升 +1.20 个百分点。

source: Looped transformers ⟦0⟧, Universal Transformers ⟦1⟧, and Deep Equilibrium models ⟦2⟧ all incorporate recurrence into the architecture ⟦3⟧ and weights ⟦4⟧. Layers are tied across loop iterations and optimized accordingly, so the recurrence structure is inseparable from the trained parameters. As a consequence, looping cannot be applied to a model that was not trained with this methodology in mind, which is the case for almost all publicly released languagemodel checkpoints. This naturally gives rise to the core question of this paper:
translation: 循环变换器⟦0⟧、通用变换器⟦1⟧和深度均衡模型⟦2⟧都将循环性融入架构⟦3⟧和权重⟦4⟧中。层在循环迭代间绑定并相应优化，因此循环结构与训练参数密不可分。因此，循环无法应用于未按此方法论训练的模型，而几乎所有公开发布的语言模型检查点都是如此。这自然引出了本文的核心问题：

source: Can we loop a frozen, off-the-shelf checkpoint directly at inference time, with no fine-tuning, no continued training, no auxiliary parameters, and no architectural changes?
translation: 能否在推理时直接循环一个冻结的现成检查点，无需微调、无需继续训练、无需辅助参数、也无需架构更改？

source: Concretely, modern open-weight LLMs, such as Qwen3 ⟦0⟧, Llama-3.2 ⟦1⟧, Moonlight ⟦2⟧, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite ⟦3⟧, are the endpoints of a multi-stage pipeline that typically includes continued pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and one or more rounds of RLHF / DPO post-training ⟦4⟧. We take whatever weights the model authors release and apply the loop wrapper at inference, with no further weight updates of any kind.

source: 4 Related work

source: Looped and recurrent-depth transformers.
translation: 循环与递归深度变换器。

source: A large body of work incorporates recurrence into the transformer at training time, from weight-tied stacks ⟦0⟧ and looped expressivity results ⟦1⟧ to length-generalization studies ⟦2⟧ and looped pretraining at scale ⟦3⟧. Adaptive-recursion variants ⟦4⟧ and implicit-depth fixed points ⟦5⟧ likewise tie recurrence to training, as do recent elastic-depth latent reasoning models ⟦6⟧. Our wrapper instead targets unmodified released checkpoints ⟦7⟧ with no training ⟦8⟧, no auxiliary loss, and no architectural changes.
translation: 大量工作将递归引入训练阶段的变换器，从权重绑定堆叠⟦0⟧和循环表达能力结果⟦1⟧，到长度泛化研究⟦2⟧和大规模循环预训练⟦3⟧。自适应递归变体⟦4⟧和隐式深度不动点⟦5⟧同样将递归与训练绑定，最近的弹性深度潜在推理模型⟦6⟧也是如此。我们的包装器则针对未修改的已发布检查点⟦7⟧，无需训练⟦8⟧、无辅助损失、无架构改动。

source: Inference-time compute and latent reasoning.
translation: 推理时计算与潜在推理。

source: A separate axis spends test-time compute on longer trajectories, e.g. chain-of-thought ⟦0⟧, self-consistency ⟦1⟧, and reasoning-trained LMs ⟦2⟧, all leaving the per-token forward unchanged; theory characterizes their advantages ⟦3⟧. Latent-reasoning lines instead push compute into a continuous space ⟦4⟧ or use adaptive halting to “ponder” ⟦5⟧, echoing the tuned-lens view of forward computation as iterative refinement ⟦6⟧ and layer-redundancy findings ⟦7⟧. Our intervention is orthogonal, as we use more compute per token within a single forward pass on a frozen checkpoint.
translation: 另一条轴线将测试时计算用于更长的轨迹，例如思维链⟦0⟧、自洽性⟦1⟧和经过推理训练的语言模型⟦2⟧，这些方法均保持逐令牌前向传播不变；理论刻画了它们的优势⟦3⟧。潜在推理路线则将计算推入连续空间⟦4⟧，或使用自适应停止来“思考”⟦5⟧，呼应了将前向计算视为迭代精化的调谐透镜观点⟦6⟧和层冗余发现⟦7⟧。我们的干预是正交的，因为我们在冻结检查点的单次前向传播中为每个令牌使用更多计算。

source: Numerical analysis methods.
translation: 数值分析方法。

source: Treating a residual block as a forward Euler step motivates the family of integration strategies our wrapper exposes on the looped window, in line with the fixed-point picture ⟦1⟧. Within that family we benchmark Picard acceleration via Anderson ⟦2⟧, heavyball ⟦3⟧, Aitken extrapolation, and higher-order Runge–Kutta solvers, and find none robustly beats⟦0⟧-stage Runge–Kutta, suggesting the looped middle of a pretrained transformer ⟦4⟧ is not contractive in any useful sense ⟦5⟧. Concurrent training-free directions manipulate depth via layer skipping ⟦6⟧, but to our knowledge, no prior method combines mid-block looping and layer-mode iteration for MoE routing ⟦7⟧ across modern checkpoints ⟦8⟧.
translation: 将残差块视为前向欧拉步，激发了我们的包装器在循环窗口上暴露的积分策略族，这与不动点图景⟦1⟧一致。在该族中，我们基准测试了通过安德森加速⟦2⟧、重球法⟦3⟧、艾特肯外推和高阶龙格-库塔求解器实现的皮卡德加速，发现没有一种方法能稳健地优于⟦0⟧阶龙格-库塔，这表明预训练变换器⟦4⟧的循环中间部分在任何有用意义上都不是收缩的⟦5⟧。并行的免训练方向通过层跳过⟦6⟧操纵深度，但据我们所知，没有先前方法在现代检查点⟦8⟧上结合中间块循环和层模式迭代用于专家混合路由⟦7⟧。

source: 5 Conclusion
translation: 5 结论

source: Our training-free wrapper applies to frozen released checkpoints (Qwen3, Llama-3.2, DeepSeek-V2- Lite, Moonlight, Qwen1.5-MoE) by reinterpreting each pre-norm transformer block as a forward Euler step at⟦0⟧ and providing a better approximation via iterating a contiguous loop window⟦1⟧ times. Block-mode and layer-mode iteration are both supported, with layer-mode required on MoE backbones to stabilize per-layer routing. A universal depth-fraction rule places the optimal window at fractional depth⟦2⟧0.45–0.60 across dense and MoE architectures from 16 to 48 layers. Gains concentrate on knowledge-heavy multiple-choice benchmarks (MMLU-Pro ⟦3⟧, GPQA-Main ⟦4⟧, ARC-Challenge ⟦5⟧), where our method adds roughly +2 pp, and 87% of cells across seven model families and our benchmark suite are non-negative under the fixed out-of-the-box recipe with no per-cell hyperparameter tuning.
translation: 我们的免训练包装器适用于冻结的已发布检查点（Qwen3、Llama-3.2、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、Moonlight、Qwen1.5-MoE），通过将每个预归一化变换器块重新解释为在⟦0⟧处的前向欧拉步骤，并通过迭代连续循环窗口⟦1⟧次来提供更好的近似。块模式和层模式迭代均受支持，其中层模式在MoE骨干上必需，以稳定每层路由。通用深度分数规则将最优窗口置于分数深度⟦2⟧0.45–0.60之间，适用于从16到48层的稠密和MoE架构。增益集中在知识密集型多项选择基准（MMLU-Pro ⟦3⟧、GPQA-Main ⟦4⟧、ARC-Challenge ⟦5⟧）上，我们的方法在这些基准上增加了约+2个百分点，并且在七个模型家族和我们的基准套件中，87%的单元格在固定的开箱即用配方下为非负值，且无需逐单元格超参数调优。

source: The looped forward pass we patch into a frozen model has two regimes that share most code but differ in how the loop body interacts with the KV cache. During prefill ⟦0⟧ > 1, no past KV) the loop body is run with ⟦1⟧ and writes nothing to the cache; only a single stash pass after the loop writes the canonical KV. During decode ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ 1, an existing past KV) the loop body must attend to the past KV; otherwise, the new token is computed against a truncated context. However, it must also produce no net KV writes, since the stash pass will write the canonical entry afterwards. The mechanism is to snapshot per-loop-layer cache lengths before each loop iteration and crop back to those lengths immediately after.
translation: 我们修补到冻结模型中的循环前向传播包含两种状态，它们共享大部分代码，但在循环体与键值缓存的交互方式上有所不同。在预填充阶段⟦0⟧ > 1，没有过去的键值缓存），循环体以⟦1⟧运行，并且不向缓存写入任何内容；只有在循环之后的一次暂存传递才会写入规范的键值。在解码阶段⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧ 1，存在过去的键值缓存），循环体必须关注过去的键值缓存；否则，新标记将基于截断的上下文进行计算。然而，它也必须不产生任何净键值写入，因为暂存传递随后会写入规范条目。其机制是在每次循环迭代之前快照每个循环层的缓存长度，并在迭代之后立即裁剪回这些长度。

source: C.2 Snapshot/restore
translation: C.2 快照/恢复

source: transformers.DynamicCache.update() unconditionally appends the new⟦0⟧ to its per-layer tensor: there is no in-place overwrite mode. A naive⟦1⟧-iteration decode body would therefore write ⟦2⟧ extra KV entries per loop layer at the same logical decode position, then attend to all of them on the next decode step, corrupting the cache and producing a sequence of phantom prefix tokens. The snapshot/restore pattern is the cheapest fix that (a) lets each loop iteration attend to the genuine past KV and (b) leaves the cache exactly as it was pre-iteration. The single canonical KV is then written by the stash pass on the chosen ⟦4⟧ layer-mode looping uses an analogous per-layer snapshot/crop pair, applied⟦3⟧ times to one layer before moving on.
translation: 变换器（Transformer）的动态缓存（DynamicCache）更新方法无条件地将新的⟦0⟧追加到其逐层张量中：不存在原地覆盖模式。因此，一个朴素的⟦1⟧次迭代解码循环体会在同一逻辑解码位置为每个循环层写入⟦2⟧个额外的键值（KV）条目，然后在下一个解码步骤中关注所有这些条目，从而破坏缓存并产生一系列幻影前缀标记。快照/恢复模式是最经济的修复方案，它（a）让每次循环迭代都能关注到真实的过去键值，并且（b）使缓存在迭代前保持原样。随后，由暂存过程在选定的⟦4⟧上写入唯一的规范键值。层模式循环使用类似的逐层快照/裁剪对，在移动到下一层之前对一层应用⟦3⟧次。

source: N.1 KV cache handling
translation: N.1 键值缓存处理

source: For autoregressive inference ⟦2⟧ we must reconcile loop iteration with the key/value (KV) cache. A naive implementation of running⟦0⟧ iterations with KV writes enabled would either append⟦1⟧ entries per loop layer per position, corrupting attention masks and inflating memory, or, if iterated in place, overwrite past entries with intermediate iterates that no post-loop layer ever consumed.
translation: 对于自回归推理⟦2⟧，我们必须协调循环迭代与键值（KV）缓存。一种朴素的实现方式是在启用KV写入的情况下运行⟦0⟧次迭代，这要么会为每个循环层每个位置追加⟦1⟧个条目，从而破坏注意力掩码并膨胀内存，要么如果原地迭代，则会用循环后层从未消费过的中间迭代覆盖过去的条目。

source: We resolve this with the following two-phase scheme. In the first phase, every⟦0⟧-evaluation inside the loop body runs with ⟦3⟧ (or, during decode, with the snapshot/restore protocol), so no KV entry is written. In the second phase, after the loop terminates, one additional pass through the loop layers⟦1⟧ writes KV with ⟦4⟧ using a cache strategy ⟦2⟧ that selects which hidden state to use as input to that pass:
translation: 我们通过以下两阶段方案解决此问题。在第一阶段，循环体内的每次⟦0⟧评估均以⟦3⟧运行（或在解码期间采用快照/恢复协议），因此不写入任何键值缓存条目。在第二阶段，循环终止后，额外一次遍历循环层⟦1⟧，使用缓存策略⟦2⟧选择哪个隐藏状态作为该次遍历的输入，并以⟦4⟧写入键值缓存：

source: Here⟦0⟧ is the input to layer⟦1⟧. The cache thus contains exactly⟦2⟧ KV entries per token in the loop region, identical in shape to the unmodified model. All numbers in this paper use⟦3⟧ unless stated otherwise.
translation: 这里⟦0⟧是层⟦1⟧的输入。因此，缓存中循环区域内每个标记恰好包含⟦2⟧个KV条目，与未修改模型的形状相同。除非另有说明，本文中的所有数字均使用⟦3⟧。

source: Cache strategy is the largest individual lever in the loop-wrapper configuration (first⟦0⟧ last⟦1⟧ none). Appendix G reports the ⟦2⟧ catastrophe; here we report the positive finding that the two well-formed cache strategies (first and last) both produce positive deltas on the headline cells, with which one is best determined by the structure of the generated answer.
translation: 缓存策略是循环包装器配置中最大的单一杠杆（首个⟦0⟧ 末个⟦1⟧ 无）。附录G报告了⟦2⟧灾难；此处报告积极发现：两种结构良好的缓存策略（首个和末个）在主要单元格上均产生正增量，其中最佳策略由生成答案的结构决定。

source: Table 20: Qwen3-4B-Instruct ⟦1⟧⟦0⟧ Euler under three cache strategies. ⟦2⟧ (pre-loop hidden state stashed) dominates long-prompt CoT; ⟦3⟧ (post-loop hidden state stashed) dominates short structured generation; both well-formed strategies are non-negative on every headline cell tested.
translation: 表20：Qwen3-4B-Instruct ⟦1⟧⟦0⟧ 欧拉在三种缓存策略下的表现。⟦2⟧（循环前隐藏状态暂存）在长提示思维链中占优；⟦3⟧（循环后隐藏状态暂存）在短结构化生成中占优；两种结构良好的策略在所有测试的主要单元格上均为非负。

source: Two well-formed cache choices, two simultaneously positive cells. The implication for deployment is that cache choice should swap on the basis of whether the generated answer is long free-form prose (first) or short structured tokens (last) rather than a brittle binary that requires per-benchmark search.
translation: 两种结构良好的缓存选择，两个同时为正的单元格。对部署的启示是：缓存选择应根据生成答案是长自由散文（首个）还是短结构化标记（末个）进行切换，而非依赖需要逐基准搜索的脆弱二元选择。

source: O Per-architecture implementation notes
translation: O 各架构实现说明

source: The training-free wrapper is a contiguous monkey-patch on the model’s top-level decoder class. The patch shape is identical across families, but the integration points differ because each architecture’s reference transformers implementation exposes the layer-iteration loop in a slightly different macro. Table 21 summarizes the patch surface for each backbone.
translation: 免训练包装器是对模型顶层解码器类的连续猴子补丁。补丁形状在各系列间相同，但集成点不同，因为每种架构的参考变换器实现以略有不同的宏暴露层迭代循环。表21总结了每个骨干网络的补丁表面。

source: DynamicCache compatibility shim (MLA backbones).
translation: 动态缓存兼容性垫片（多头潜在注意力骨干网络）。

source: DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Moonlight ship their own DynamicCache-derived class via remote code, which expects the older transformers cache API ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ Newer transformers drops these attributes. Our patch installs a thin compatibility shim that re-adds the three deprecated entry points on top of the modern cache, so the released remote code runs unchanged. The shim is non-invasive and is reversed on patch unload.
translation: DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Moonlight通过远程代码提供其自身的动态缓存派生类，该类期望旧版变换器缓存API ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧。新版变换器移除了这些属性。我们的补丁安装了一个薄兼容性垫片，在现代缓存之上重新添加三个已弃用的入口点，使发布的远程代码无需修改即可运行。该垫片非侵入式，并在补丁卸载时撤销。

source: Table 21: Where the loop wrapper attaches in each backbone’s transformers implementation. “Patch surface” is the line range we replace on the released model code; “MLA” marks multi-head latent attention models, which need the cache-shim described below.
translation: 表21：循环包装器在各骨干网络变换器实现中的附加位置。“补丁表面”是我们在已发布模型代码上替换的行范围；“多头潜在注意力”标记多头潜在注意力模型，这些模型需要下文所述的缓存垫片。

source: Layer-mode entry point.
translation: 层模式入口点。

source: On MoE backbones, layer-mode iteration is implemented by replacing the layer loop with a per-layer iterator ⟦0⟧ Block-mode and layer-mode share a single dispatch in our code that selects the iterator based on the ⟦1⟧ flag; switching modes requires no further backbone-specific work. On dense backbones we expose layer-mode for parity but block-mode is the default.
translation: 在混合专家（MoE）骨干网络上，层模式迭代通过将层循环替换为逐层迭代器 ⟦0⟧ 来实现。块模式与层模式在我们的代码中共享单一分派，该分派根据 ⟦1⟧ 标志选择迭代器；切换模式无需进一步的骨干特定工作。在稠密骨干网络上，我们为保持一致性也提供层模式，但块模式为默认模式。

source: KV cache writes are the only side effect.
translation: 键值缓存写入是唯一的副作用。

source: The patch is otherwise stateless: it maintains no auxiliary buffers beyond a Θ(⟦0⟧ activation buffer for the iteration strategy, and the snapshot/restore protocol is allocation-free. Restarting a patched model from a fresh ⟦1⟧ call yields bit-exact baseline outputs, confirming the wrapper introduces no silent state across runs.
translation: 该补丁在其他方面是无状态的：除为迭代策略维护一个 Θ(⟦0⟧) 激活缓冲区外，不维护任何辅助缓冲区，且快照/恢复协议不涉及内存分配。从全新的 ⟦1⟧ 调用重新启动打过补丁的模型可产生与基线逐位一致的输出，证实该包装器在多次运行之间不会引入任何隐藏状态。

source: The 45 (model, benchmark) cells in Section 3.4 are the result of a structured per-cell search rather than an open-ended sweep. We document the protocol here so the per-cell numbers in Appendix D are reproducible and so the relative prevalence of failed configurations in Appendix G can be contextualized.

source: plus, where applicable, a layer-mode counterpart at the same (window,⟦0⟧). translation: 两阶段验证。

source: Each candidate is first scored on the 16-task aggregate (the screen). Top-3 candidates per cell are then re-scored on the held-out MMLU 5-shot (⟦0⟧14k examples) at the same prompt. Only configurations that are non-negative on both the screen and the held-out check are retained (Appendix J). Configurations that beat the screen by⟦1⟧ pp but regress on held-out are flagged as overfit-to-screen and reported in Appendix G.

source: Stopping rule.

source: A search for a (model, benchmark) cell terminates when either (i) the best held-out score has not improved across the last six configurations tried, or (ii) the per-cell GPU budget exceeds 8 hours on H100-80. Cells that hit the budget without a non-negative held-out score are reported as “did not flip” and listed in Appendix G.
translation: 当满足以下任一条件时，对（模型，基准）单元的搜索终止：（i）最近尝试的六个配置中，最佳留出分数没有提高，或（ii）每个单元的GPU预算在H100-80上超过8小时。在未获得非负留出分数的情况下达到预算的单元被报告为“未翻转”，并列于附录G中。
